about:
Westmoreland Plastics Co operates from Latrobe, Pennsylvania, where it has been producing custom thermoset and thermoplastic molded components for more than fifty years. The company was founded as a custom molding specialist and has served a wide variety of industries for over five decades.

The company manufactures thermoset and thermoplastic molded parts and sub-assemblies, offering in-house tooling design and build as well as the ability to run customer-supplied molds. Its value-added services include lapping and fine grinding to meet precise dimensional requirements. Westmoreland Plastics handles both thermoset and thermoplastic materials, though specific material grades are not publicly listed.

Its components are used in aerospace, appliances, circuit breakers, electrical distribution equipment, lighting fixtures, medical and metering devices, sensors, and temperature controls. The customer base spans original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers in these regulated sectors.

Westmoreland Plastics emphasizes its ISO 9001-certified quality system, a willingness to adopt innovative processing methods, and the ability to meet tight production schedules through custom tooling and molding expertise.
